description: Staked alpha trajectory and net flow into a specific Bittensor subnet over historical pool snapshots: net flow in alpha (with its TAO value at the newest point's price), direction (inflow/outflow), and point-in-time pool stakes. Requires TAOSTATS_API_KEY. Related tools on this server, for a different need: crypto_tao_subnet_validators when you need Top validators of a specific Bittensor subnet by stake; crypto_tao_subnet_concentration when you need Stake and emission concentration analysis for a Bittensor. Price: $0.005 in USDC per successful call, paid with x402 (Base, Solana or Arc); failed calls are not charged.
